# The Inner Sanctum

Date: 2026-10-30

## Summary
The investigators began at the Silver Twilight Lodge on Harmon Street, where Reverend Marsh talked his way into the members' reading room on the strength of his collar. Mal slipped away to the office and found a ledger with an entry for "preparations at the St. Anselm's site," which turned the party toward the old church that same night.

In the crypt beneath St. Anselm's, Mal found a draught behind the ossuary wall and the party forced a narrow passage into a cold stone corridor carved with the strange symbol. Chanting rose from below. Dr. Voss, checking the walls by lamplight, realised the carvings had been cut recently, by an unpractised hand.

They found Professor Ashford in a cell beside a library of forbidden texts, thin and feverish, still copying passages by candle stub. He would not leave without his notes. While Marsh argued with him in whispers, Brother Ezra and four robed cultists entered the ritual chamber beyond. The party scuffed out part of the floor pattern while the chant was at its loudest, and in the confusion carried Ashford up through the crypt. Brother Ezra was last seen at the edge of the pit, watching them go and making no move to follow.

## Memorable Moments
> "I have married, buried and christened half of Arkham. I can certainly read a newspaper in your club."
> — Reverend Silas Marsh

*Marsh's answer to the lodge steward who asked whether he was a member*

**Mal lit a match at the ossuary wall and watched the flame lean toward the skulls.**

*How the party found the hidden passage beneath St. Anselm's*

> "Professor, you are not going back for your notes. I am your physician and that is an order."
> — Dr. Eleanor Voss

*Voss, carrying half of Ashford's weight up the crypt stairs while he reached back toward the library*

**Brother Ezra did not chase them. He stood at the lip of the pit and raised one hand, as if waving goodbye.**

*The last the party saw of the ritual chamber*

## Scenes
### The Silver Twilight Lodge
#### The investigators visit the lodge on Harmon Street to follow the Order's trail
- Reverend Marsh bluffs his way into the members' reading room.
- Mal searches the office and finds a ledger naming the St. Anselm's site.

### Into the Crypt
#### The party returns to St. Anselm's at night and finds the hidden way down
- Mal finds the false wall in the ossuary by the draught behind it.
- Dr. Voss notices that the carved symbols in the corridor are fresh.

### The Prisoner in the Library
#### The party finds Professor Ashford and the cult arrives
- Ashford is found in a cell beside the library, still translating.
- He refuses to leave without his notes; Marsh and Voss persuade him.
- Brother Ezra and four cultists enter the ritual chamber.

### Escape from the Ritual Chamber
#### The party breaks the floor pattern and flees with Ashford
- The investigators scuff out part of the floor pattern under cover of the chant.
- They carry Ashford up through the crypt. Brother Ezra does not follow.

## NPCs
### Brother Ezra
Leader of the cultists beneath St. Anselm's. He watched the investigators escape with Professor Ashford and did not pursue them.

### Professor Ashford
Found alive in a cell beneath the church, weak and feverish, compelled to translate forbidden texts for the cult. Rescued by the investigators.

### The Lodge Steward
An elderly doorman at the Silver Twilight Lodge who let Reverend Marsh into the reading room.

## Locations
### St. Anselm's Church
The old church whose crypt hides a passage, behind a false wall in the ossuary, down to the cult's underground chambers.

### Silver Twilight Lodge
A respectable brownstone on Harmon Street with a brass plaque, presented as a gentlemen's social club.

## Items
### Ashford's Translation Notes
Pages of the professor's translations, carried out of the library by Dr. Voss.
